verdict.rationale: x402 is a per-request HTTP payment protocol with a hosted facilitator. The evidence shows agents can pay autonomously mid-task and that batch settlement supports high-frequency agent loops, but these are payment building blocks used by an external agent. Nothing shows the product lets a user configure, schedule, or run background automations. Since a payments platform could plausibly offer automated or recurring workflows, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
